news_feeds.body:
No new official data over the weekend. CPI (core hot), PPI and ECB hike remain locked. USD Inflation pillar at full support; FOMC hike odds elevated for 16-17 Sep.

New CFTC COT (as of 8 Sep) released Friday. Full TFF Leveraged Funds rescoring still deferred until complete extract — prior nets retained with explicit carried flag.

Thin weekend liquidity. Next catalyst: FOMC.
